summary: Tested new deep-link route /documents/:id and 'Salin Tautan' copy-link feature. All 6 acceptance criteria PASS: (1) deep-link renders document-page + document-detail, (2) notfound state renders with back-to-dashboard button, (3) copy-doc-link copies correct shareable URL and shows toast 'Tautan dokumen disalin' (clipboard verified via navigator.clipboard.readText), (4) end-to-end create PPBJ via POST /api/documents then open /documents/{id} works, (5) auth guard redirects unauthenticated user to /login, (6) regression: list modal still opens via view-{id} and modal detail also contains the copy-doc-link button. No console errors during flow (only harmless 401s on public routes and 404 for the intentional nonexistent id test).

issues: Sticky header can intercept clicks on the Salin Tautan / Cetak PDF buttons at the top of the modal when the modal content scrolls past. Cosmetic only; buttons are functional when in view. Consider z-index/positioning fix or placing action bar below sticky header offset.

critical_code_review_comments: DocumentPage.jsx correctly handles loading/ok/notfound states and treats any error as notfound; consider distinguishing network errors from 404 for better UX.
copyLink() gracefully falls back to window.prompt when clipboard API is unavailable — good.
